message: OTA-9 rv3.0.0: OAuth Spotify con state anti-CSRF — sicurezza rafforzata
note: Task #475 fix code review. (1) Backend /auth-url genera crypto.randomBytes(16) state, lo salva in req.session.spotifyOauthState e lo include nei params Spotify. (2) Backend /callback valida state === req.session.spotifyOauthState (400 se mancante/non coincide), poi cancella dallo store. (3) Frontend estrae result.params.state e lo invia a /callback. (4) Build fix: esbuild alias @shared/schema=./shared/schema aggiunto in start-backend.sh. CURRENT_OTA_NUMBER=9.
